name: insider-horse-racing
description: Interactive horse racing game built with Vue 3, TypeScript and Pinia.

scripts.test:e2e:docker: docker run --rm --ipc=host -v "$PWD":/work -v horse-racing-pw-modules:/work/node_modules -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.65.1-noble sh -c "npm ci && npx playwright test --grep-invert @visual"
scripts.test:visual:docker: docker run --rm --ipc=host -v "$PWD":/work -v horse-racing-pw-modules:/work/node_modules -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.65.1-noble sh -c "npm ci && npx playwright test --grep @visual"
scripts.test:visual:update:docker: docker run --rm --ipc=host -v "$PWD":/work -v horse-racing-pw-modules:/work/node_modules -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.65.1-noble sh -c "npm ci && npx playwright test --grep @visual --update-snapshots"
